messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Does camtrapR work with videos
parts:
Hi,
yes, camtrapR works with videos. See this post on the group.
The links  the vignettes given there don't work anymore though, so use these instead:
vignette 1
vignette 2

While videos are supported and can be used alongside JPG files, there are some limitations, most notably:
  • due to non-standardized video metadata you first need to figure out which (if any) metadata tag contains the relevant date/time information
  • digiKam tags are not saved inside the video file, but only reside in the digiKam database (in contrast, metadata tags are saved inside JPG metadata). This means video tags can be lost when the database breaks or files are moved, and it may be a headache when migrating a digiKam database.
Maybe other users can provide feedback about how well it works. There are also a few more threads here on the group.
Best regards
